text_zh: 加赠50%挺香的，囤了一波金币，周末打高倍场够用了
text_en: The 50% bonus is great. I stocked up on coins, enough for high-stakes tables all weekend.

text_zh: 4.99拿6万金币很值，平时根本不舍得买
text_en: 60,000 coins for $4.99 is a great deal. Normally I would never spend on coins.

text_zh: 我周三刚在商城买了4.99的包，特惠礼包同价金币多一倍，亏了
text_en: I bought the regular $4.99 pack on Wednesday, and the special bundle gives twice the coins for the same price. I lost out.

text_zh: 以后只等特惠礼包了，商城的包太不划算
text_en: From now on I will only wait for the special bundle. The regular shop packs are bad value.

text_zh: 特惠也要4.99，一个礼包够打几局啊
text_en: Even the bundle is $4.99. How many matches does one bundle even last?

text_zh: 付了钱金币没到账！！！客服两天没回
text_en: Paid but the coins never arrived!!! Support hasn't replied in two days.

text_zh: 特惠礼包显示购买成功但金币没到，重启也没用
text_en: The bundle said the purchase succeeded but the coins never arrived. Restarting didn't help.

text_zh: 高倍场全是充钱的大佬，我们这种不充的根本进不去
text_en: High-stakes tables are full of big spenders. Non-payers like us can't even get in.

text_zh: 一上线就弹窗，关了又弹，烦
text_en: Pop-up every time I log in. Close it and it pops up again. Annoying.

text_zh: 这个活动可以常驻吗，每个月来一次也行
text_en: Can this be permanent? Even once a month would be fine.

text_zh: 想买但这个月没钱了，下次吧
text_en: Wanted to buy but I'm out of money this month. Next time.

text_zh: 一天只能买一个特惠礼包，想多买都不行
text_en: You can only buy one bundle a day. I wanted more and couldn't.

text_zh: 充钱的人金币多，可以一直输一直打，不公平
text_en: Payers have so many coins they can keep losing and keep playing. Not fair.

text_zh: 第一次充值就买了特惠礼包，金币够我学一阵子了
text_en: My first top-up was the special bundle. The coins will last me a while as I learn.

text_zh: 能不能出个组队玩法
text_en: Can you add a team play mode?

text_zh: 每天上来赢一把领奖励，挺有动力的
text_en: Log in, win one hand, get the reward. Gives me a reason to play every day.

text_zh: 每天领2000金币，够我多打好几局
text_en: 2,000 free coins every day means I can play a few more matches.

text_zh: 打了一晚上一把都没赢，首胜奖励跟我没关系
text_en: Played all evening without winning a single hand. The first-win reward has nothing to do with me.

text_zh: 新手怎么跟老手打啊，能不能按水平匹配
text_en: How are newbies supposed to beat veterans? Can matchmaking go by skill level?

text_zh: 2000金币打一局低倍场就没了，太少
text_en: 2,000 coins are gone after one low-stakes match. Too little.

text_zh: 一天只能领一次，赢了第一把就没动力继续打了
text_en: Only once a day. After the first win there's no reason to keep playing.

text_zh: 同桌另外三个人出手速度一模一样，肯定是机器人
text_en: The other three players all play at exactly the same speed. Definitely bots.

text_zh: 最近机器人好多，是不是为了让人刷首胜
text_en: So many bots lately. Are they there so people can farm first wins?

text_zh: 晚上八点排队要等一分钟
text_en: At 8 pm the queue takes a whole minute.

text_zh: 规则还没搞懂，分数怎么算的
text_en: I still haven't figured out the rules. How is scoring calculated?

text_zh: 比签到有意思，至少要真的打几局
text_en: More interesting than a check-in. At least you actually have to play.

text_zh: 奖励还行吧，反正每天都要上来打几局
text_en: The reward is okay. I log in to play a few matches every day anyway.

text_zh: 连续三把都是同一个头像的玩家，太假了
text_en: Same avatar player three games in a row. So fake.

text_zh: 老是被老手秒杀，首胜要等好几天
text_en: Veterans keep winning instantly. It takes me days to get a first win.

text_zh: 求出个好友房，想和朋友一起打
text_en: Please add private rooms, I want to play with friends.
